description: A book, essay or story, judged: should you give a shit about reading it? YAML frontmatter built key by key, a wikilinked byline, an optional cover image, 'The pitch' abstract callout, quotes as receipts deep-linked into the source text, a 'How it aged' table, marginalia, a collapsed spoilers callout, a connections link cloud, an embedded up-next note and footnotes. Section headings, callout kinds and callout titles belong to the template; write values only. Plain strings, no markdown: the template does all formatting.

title.role: work title; page heading, frontmatter `title`, cover alt text, and (kebab-cased) frontmatter `slug`

author.role: author name, rendered as an [[author]] wikilink in the byline; falls back to Anonymous (no wikilink) via ??

status.role: reading status: reading|finished|abandoned; falls back to read via ??

source_url.role: URL of the full text (http/https, no #fragment); the 'read it free' link, frontmatter `source`, and the deep-link target for every quote

verdict.role: two-to-four word reading verdict, rendered bold, e.g. read it tonight|skim it|skip it

take.role: one-line hot take after the verdict

summary.role: the pitch, 2-4 sentences, single paragraph, body of 'The pitch' abstract callout. No spoilers

text.role: verbatim quote copied from the page at `source_url`, one line. Rendered with a #:~:text= deep link, so it must match the source text exactly; avoid curly quotes

note.role: key into `notes`; renders a [^key] footnote ref. Must match a `notes` key exactly

aged.role: pipe table; first row is the header: ["<author surname>, <year>", "us, now", "called it?"], then one row per prediction. Every row has 3 cells; no | or newlines in cells

spoilers.role: the ending, single paragraph, body of the collapsed 'Spoilers' warning callout

connections.role: names of existing site pages (author, influences, collections); rendered as [[wikilinks]] in frontmatter `related` and the Connections link cloud. Name only pages that exist; an invented name is a dangling wikilink

up_next.role: name of an existing site page, embedded as ![[name]] under 'Up next'

notes.role: footnotes: key -> note text, rendered as [^key]: definitions. Keys are short kebab-case labels. Every key must be referenced by some quote `note`, and every `note` must be a key here; format_check flags strays
